name: 92509 · Riverside, CA
findings: ZIP 92509 (Riverside) has 138 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92509 (Riverside) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92509 (Riverside) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 43 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 92509 (Riverside) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 38 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 38 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
